Title: IT Service Management Connector (ITSMC) is now available in Azure Government

Body.Content:
The IT Service Management Connector (ITSMC) allows you to connect Azure and a supported IT Service Management (ITSM) product/service.

Azure services like Log Analytics and Azure Monitor provide tools to detect, analyze and troubleshoot issues with your Azure and non-Azure resources to enable work item integration with IT Service Management products.  The ITSM connector provides a bi-directional connection between Azure and ITSM tools to help track and resolve issues faster.

ITSMC is now generally available in Azure Government, and integrates with Azure Log Analytics in both Virginia and Arizona regions.
